description: She wears a plum-purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline and fitted bodice. Gold woven borders decorate the neckline, front panels, sleeve cuffs and skirt hem. Circular gold brooches fasten near both shoulder straps. Sleeves end around the elbows, with a cream patterned wrap draped loosely around both forearms and down the sides. A gold belt with three round decorative medallions secures the waist. An ivory underdress shows through the front skirt opening, above patterned gold-brown shoes. No headgear, armor or weapons are present.
